provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.example.paths directly introduces shared.typing.example.paths. Uses the already-defined composition table and local declarations to explain whole-type permission routes. Does not require a forward call to the later focusing algorithm. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. The permission_paths example asserts the four static give results for b.item, s.item, o.box.item, h.item. The given case updates the source view; the three shared cases preserve the environment. Its classes and declared permissions match the displayed Box/Outer/Holder setup. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
